summary: Build protocol-aware retry behavior with idempotency, bounded backoff, cancellation, concurrency control, and terminal evidence.
triggers: A client receives documented rate-limit responses and needs bounded recovery.
Retry delay, jitter, idempotency, or exhaustion behavior needs implementation or review.
A request may be retried while its commit status is uncertain.
antiTriggers: Evade a provider quota or access policy.
Retry a non-idempotent mutation without a deduplication contract.
Claim provider behavior from client-side fixtures alone.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Inputs, retry operations, failure modes, and termination semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; this entrypoint makes no performance or certification claim.
